effect_led_id.openrazer: 0x00 (ZERO_LED) for whole-device set_*_effect; zone methods use the ids below

notes: PID 0x0F1F: OpenRazer sends lighting with 0x3F but other commands with 0xFF (functions: read_device_mode, read_device_serial, write_device_mode)

Two interfaces: interface 0 carries the normal 90-byte commands, interface 1 a larger ARGB frame report (report id 0x04 for channels 0-4, 0x84 for channel 5+, header [channel, channel, pad, last_idx] + up to 315 colour bytes). OpenRazer razercommon.c razer_send_argb_msg and OpenRGB RazerController.cpp razer_create_custom_frame_argb_report agree. 6 channels x up to 80 LEDs; channel LED ids 0x1A-0x1F.
